text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple connected paragraphs","quality":"text development","description":"This captures having enough elaboration and supporting points to build an argument rather than only a few fragments."},{"evidence":"sentences about teachers helping after school and students asking questions","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"This captures developing the main idea with reasons and examples instead of leaving it implicit."},{"evidence":"repeated use of transitions like \"but,\" \"because,\" and \"so\"","quality":"cohesive linking","description":"This captures using logical connectors to relate ideas across clauses and sentences."},{"evidence":"mostly full sentences even with errors","quality":"sentence-level control","description":"This captures producing extended sentence structures that remain readable despite grammar mistakes."},{"evidence":"topic vocabulary such as \"homework,\" \"tutoring,\" and \"understand\"","quality":"relevant vocabulary","description":"This captures using words that fit the writing task and help express the intended meaning."}]}
